status_boundary: Schema-free package-local implementation register; not a legal, financial, engineering, safety, accessibility, labor, rights, or field risk certification.

records.trigger: committed journal, receipt, ledger, fixture, oracle, or derived record is deleted, rewritten, or replaced
records.mitigation: Append-only retention, immutable committed inputs, current manifest hashes, independent output hashes, access logging, and human incident review.

records.trigger: journal sequence, previous_hash, record_hash, or execution input/output hash no longer recomputes
records.mitigation: Deterministic canonical hashing, genesis/sequence checks, runner --check, immutable fixture/oracle inputs, and independent re-computation before acceptance.

records.trigger: validator, fixtures, oracle, and expected answers are produced or changed in one unreviewed runtime step
records.mitigation: Keep validator, committed fixtures, and committed oracle separate; runner reads rather than authors expected answers; require independent change review.

records.trigger: custodian, authorization, accounting treatment, legal vehicle, or any release condition is absent or disputed
records.mitigation: Treat the current unit as synthetic only; prohibit real release unless receipt, fallback, data clearing, material destination, four ledger closings, custody, accounting, and legal authority pass professional review.

records.trigger: duplicate transaction ID, fabricated evidence hash, absent party/sign-off, unit mixing, or non-zero closing is submitted
records.mitigation: Transaction-level entries, separate units, evidence hashes, two-role sign-off, source receipt linkage, validator recomputation, and sample independent audit.

records.trigger: closed interface, unavailable repair manual or spares, blocked data/config export, proprietary custody dependency, or punitive exit cost appears
records.mitigation: Minimum repair-right package, replaceable interfaces, export and restoration tests, escrowed documentation where lawful, migration plan, and retirement trigger.

records.trigger: provisional, synthetic, derived, unknown, or package-local result is presented as official, surveyed, approved, field-validated, engineered, or implemented
records.mitigation: Visible evidence-status stamps, source/assumption closure, package-local provenance, exact forbidden-term checks, and P0 official/field/engineering input gates.

records.trigger: maintenance burden, unpaid data work, surveillance pressure, or safety exposure shifts to night, cleaning, security, delivery, or repair workers
records.mitigation: Labor ledger, workload and pay review, worker representation and stop authority, safety training, staffing fallback, and withdrawal if burden rises.

records.trigger: AI or a mobile account becomes an eligibility gate, or staffed, paper, static-wayfinding, proxy, accessible, or offline service fails
records.mitigation: Equivalent staffed and paper routes, static multimodal wayfinding, accessible interaction testing, proxy assistance, service continuity drills, and immediate AI-layer pause.

records.trigger: uncleared text, figure, media, logo, portrait, map, geometry, font, code, or peer asset enters a public artifact, or citation is mistaken for reuse permission
records.mitigation: Use official facts as citations only, retain package-local originality limits and rights QA, use self-generated programmatic media, exclude peer assets, document local font use without redistribution, and require rights review for every new external asset.
